summary: Editing an EDA project's source URL, branch/tag/commit or refspec triggers a resync: running activations keep old content until restarted (re-attach event streams first if used), new rulebooks appear, and deleted rulebooks are removed while their activations keep running.
questions: What happens to running activations when I edit an EDA project?
Do I need to restart activations after changing a rulebook?
What happens to activations if their rulebook is deleted from git?
Do I need to re-attach event streams after a project update?
